name: Peanut Butter Banana Toast
description: Toast spread with peanut butter and topped with sliced banana
instructions: Toast the bread until golden
Spread the peanut butter over the toast
Slice the banana, lay it on top and finish with a little cinnamon

name: Apple Slices with Peanut Butter
description: Crisp apple wedges with peanut butter for dipping
instructions: Core the apple and cut it into wedges
Put the peanut butter in a small bowl and dip the wedges as you eat

name: Quick Hummus with Carrot Sticks
description: Chickpeas mashed with olive oil, garlic and lemon, with carrot sticks to dip
instructions: Drain and rinse the chickpeas, then mash them with a fork or blend them with the olive oil, the crushed garlic, a squeeze of lemon juice, a pinch of salt and a spoon of water until smooth
Peel the carrots and cut them into sticks
Serve the hummus with a pinch of paprika on top and the carrot sticks on the side

name: Greek Yogurt with Blueberries and Honey
description: Thick yogurt with blueberries and a drizzle of honey
instructions: Spoon the yogurt into a bowl
Scatter the blueberries over it and drizzle with the honey

name: Cottage Cheese and Tomato Toast
description: Toast with cottage cheese, sliced tomato and a thread of olive oil
instructions: Toast the bread
Pile the cottage cheese on the toast and lay the sliced tomato on top
Drizzle with the olive oil and season with salt and black pepper

name: Avocado Toast
description: Two slices of toast with mashed avocado and tomato
instructions: Toast the bread
Mash the avocado with a squeeze of lemon juice and a pinch of salt, and spread it over the toast
Top with the diced tomato and a little black pepper

name: Boiled Eggs with Cucumber and Toast
description: Soft-boiled eggs with cucumber slices and a slice of toast
instructions: Boil the eggs for 7 minutes, cool them under cold water and peel them
Toast the bread and slice the cucumber
Halve the eggs, season with salt and black pepper, and serve with the cucumber and the toast

name: No-Bake Banana Oat Bites
description: Oats, mashed banana and peanut butter rolled into small bites
instructions: Mash the banana in a bowl with a fork
Stir in the oats, the peanut butter and a pinch of cinnamon until the mixture holds together
Roll into {6} small balls; eat them straight away or chill them for 15 minutes to firm up

name: Crispy Roasted Chickpeas
description: Chickpeas roasted with olive oil and smoked paprika until crunchy
instructions: Heat the oven to 200°C. Drain and rinse the chickpeas and pat them completely dry
Toss them with the olive oil, the smoked paprika and a pinch of salt and spread them on a baking tray
Roast for 20 to 25 minutes, shaking the tray once, until crisp

name: Yogurt with Banana and Oats
description: Plain yogurt with sliced banana and a handful of oats
instructions: Spoon the yogurt into a bowl
Slice the banana over it and sprinkle with the oats

name: Tuna and Cucumber Toast
description: Tuna mixed with yogurt on toast, topped with cucumber
instructions: Drain the tuna and mix it with the yogurt, a squeeze of lemon juice, salt and black pepper
Toast the bread and slice the cucumber
Spread the tuna over the toast and top with the cucumber

name: Cheese and Tomato Toastie
description: A small pan-toasted sandwich with melted cheese and tomato
instructions: Lay the cheese and the sliced tomato between the two slices of bread
Toast the sandwich in a dry pan over medium heat for 2 to 3 minutes on each side, pressing it down, until golden and the cheese has melted
Cut in half and eat warm

name: Strawberry Banana Smoothie
description: Banana and strawberries blended with milk
instructions: Peel the banana and hull the strawberries
Blend them with the milk until smooth and pour into a glass

name: Coconut Blueberry Smoothie
description: Banana and blueberries blended with coconut milk
instructions: Peel the banana and put it in a blender with the blueberries and the coconut milk
Add {100} ml of cold water, blend until smooth and pour into a glass

name: Ham and Cheese Roll-Ups
description: Slices of ham rolled around cheese and cucumber sticks
instructions: Cut the cheese and the cucumber into sticks
Lay a stick of each on a slice of ham, roll it up, and repeat with the rest

name: Soy-Glazed Tofu Bites
description: Cubes of tofu fried until golden and glazed with soy sauce
instructions: Pat the tofu dry and cut it into bite-sized cubes
Heat the oil in a pan over medium-high heat and fry the tofu for 6 to 8 minutes, turning, until golden on all sides
Add the soy sauce, toss for 30 seconds until it coats the tofu, and serve

name: Peanut Butter Yogurt Dip with Apple
description: Greek yogurt stirred with peanut butter, with apple wedges to dip
instructions: Stir the peanut butter into the yogurt until smooth
Core the apple, cut it into wedges and serve them with the dip

name: Egg and Avocado Toast
description: Toast with mashed avocado and sliced boiled eggs
instructions: Boil the eggs for 8 minutes, cool them under cold water, peel and slice them
Toast the bread and spread it with the avocado, mashed with a pinch of salt
Lay the egg slices on top and season with black pepper

name: Bean and Cheese Quesadilla
description: A folded tortilla filled with kidney beans and melted cheese
instructions: Drain and rinse the beans and roughly mash them with a fork, a pinch of cumin and a pinch of salt
Spread the beans over one half of the tortilla, scatter the grated cheese on top and fold the tortilla over
Toast in a dry pan over medium heat for 2 minutes on each side until crisp and the cheese has melted, then cut into wedges

name: Tofu Scramble Wrap
description: A tortilla filled with tofu scrambled with peppers
instructions: Dice the peppers and crumble the tofu with your fingers
Heat the oil in a pan over medium heat, cook the peppers for 2 minutes, then add the tofu, the turmeric, salt and black pepper and fry for 4 minutes
Spoon the scramble onto the tortilla, roll it up and cut it in half

name: Chickpea and Avocado Bowl
description: Chickpeas tossed with avocado and tomato
instructions: Drain and rinse the chickpeas and put them in a bowl
Dice the avocado and the tomato and add them to the bowl
Toss with a squeeze of lemon juice, a pinch of salt and black pepper
